name: crosslg-retain-benchmark-entg-og-sm-3-1
description: A Hugging Face dataset intended as a cross-lingual / retention-style benchmark for evaluating models' ability to retain or transfer learned representations across language or domain variants. It contains example pairs designed to probe model generalization and retention across different input perturbations and languages. The dataset is compact and aimed at focused evaluation rather than large-scale leaderboard ranking.
evaluation_method: accuracy (primary), with some tasks evaluated by exact match
reputation: Relatively low-profile, community-contributed benchmark used by a small set of researchers experimenting with cross-lingual retention and transfer.
